assumptions.choice: Use 08:00 inclusive through 09:00 exclusive, based on each 1-minute bar's timestamp.
assumptions.reason: The specification provides 08:00-09:00 as the only concrete analysis-window example; a 09:00 timestamp begins a candle outside that window.
The metric is the standard deviation of the complete set of log returns collected for each day's analysis slot.

assumptions.choice: Store a daily volatility value only when at least two valid logarithmic returns were collected.
assumptions.reason: Standard deviation is not defined for fewer than two observations.

assumptions.choice: No volatility values will be produced for the supplied AAPL feed if it contains only 09:30-and-later bars.
assumptions.reason: The required 08:00-09:00 exchange-time window is outside the stated feed coverage.
